standard_prerequisites.name: The plane-curve setup
standard_prerequisites.use: Fixes the closed subscheme Z of the projective plane with principal ideal generated by the homogeneous form F of degree d.

standard_prerequisites.name: Graded-to-sheaf exactness and projective-space cohomology
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Constructions, Lemma constructions-lemma-proj-sheaves; Cohomology of Schemes, Lemmas coherent-lemma-cohomology-projective-space-over-ring and coherent-lemma-relative-affine-cohomology
standard_prerequisites.use: Sheafifies 0 -> S(-d) -> S -> S/(F) -> 0 to 0 -> O(-d) -> O -> i_*O_Z -> 0, supplies the cohomology of O and O(-d) on the plane, and moves cohomology from Z to the ambient projective space.

core_obligations: Sheaf sequence (proof lines 1911-1925): multiplication by F gives the graded exact sequence, and sheafification yields 0 -> O_{P^2}(-d) -> O_{P^2} -> i_*O_Z -> 0 because F generates the ideal of Z.

Cohomology computation (proof lines 1926-1939): with H^q(Z, O_Z) = H^q(P^2, i_*O_Z), the long exact sequence first identifies H^0(Z, O_Z) with k, then the boundary map identifies H^1(Z, O_Z) with the degree d - 3 graded piece of k[T_0, T_1, T_2], of dimension (d - 1)(d - 2)/2, which is the genus.
proof_roadmap: Write the graded Koszul-type sequence for the principal ideal (F).
Sheafify to the exact sequence of invertible sheaves on the plane.
Push cohomology up to the projective plane and run the long exact sequence.
Read off H^0 = k and the dimension of the H^1 term as the genus formula.
difficulty_reason: The lemma computes H^0 and the genus of a plane curve of degree d (statement lines 1904-1909). The proof (lines 1911-1939) is complete: the graded sequence, its sheafification, the cohomology comparison to the ambient projective space, and the long-exact identification of H^0 with k and H^1 with a graded piece of dimension (d - 1)(d - 2)/2. Every step is present with no omissions. H2: a standard cohomological computation with correctly ordered inputs.
